pages.summary: Pansy elige su pijama frente al espejo. La noticia de que Robin pasará la noche en Derbyshire interrumpe las prendas que hacía flotar.

panels.scene: Hermione knocks at the partly open oak door, holding an ivory towel normally on one forearm. We see her in gray pajamas from the side, standing outside. Pansy speaks from inside the bedroom OFFSCREEN, balloon tail directed beyond the right edge through the doorway.
dialogue: Pansy: Pasa.

panels.scene: Pansy in her completely closed opaque navy house robe faces the vanity near open wardrobe. She holds a small towel near the ends of her black bob. Four spare garments hover separately beside the wardrobe: dark trousers, two pajama shirts and a black T-shirt. One tiny restrained magic glow supports the clothes, no hangers.
dialogue: Pansy: No consigo decidir qué ponerme.

panels.scene: Pansy turns toward Hermione with a quietly amused eyebrow, robe still closed high and tied, hands rest naturally at waist level. Only head and shoulders with wardrobe behind, no exaggerated body angle. Hermione listens from the doorway.
dialogue: Pansy: Granger, si sigues mirándome así, voy a pensar que la bata acaba de ganar la competencia.

panels.scene: Hermione on LEFT answers a little flustered. Pansy on RIGHT replies gently, no romantic touching. Hermione now lays her ivory towel over the green reading chair's back. Two ordered balloons, robes and gray pajamas fully cover them.
dialogue: Hermione: Yo no estaba…
Pansy: Tienes que mejorar esa mentira.

panels.scene: Hermione in gray pajamas becomes serious, hands free at rest by the reading chair. Her ivory towel is on the chair back, not in her hands. Same snowy guest window and lamp.
dialogue: Hermione: Mis padres no van a volver esta noche.

panels.scene: Pansy in the closed navy robe turns with concern, one small towel still in her hand. Spare pajama shirts drop loosely and rumpled onto the green duvet while trousers and T-shirt fall partly out of frame toward the rug, no clothing on a person changes.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Qué ocurrió? ¿Robin está bien?
